what: The figure list of WRITEUP.md, the project's essay: every {{name}} token of its template, what it is, where it is read and how it is written. scripts/render_writeup.py reads this file, the template, scripts/targets.json, scripts/data_pins.json, the results files and the source files named here; the template, the page and the targets are fixed in the script, never named here. It refuses a token this list does not define, an entry the template never uses (a helper must be used by another entry), a kind that matches no file or two, a value that does not fit its format, a constant whose pattern does not match exactly one line of code, any number in the template that is not a token or a declared non-result in its place, a value whose leaves read no file, bar, constant or count of the tree, a literal that is no declared factor, a results file at another commit than the rest unless its kind is a declared exception, a pinned file its kind does not declare, a figure described as another host's, a bar or figure printed so it reads other than its verdict, a sentence that ranks, compares, judges or counts with no claim or token carrying it, a missed or not-judged target left out of its census, and a verdict whose outcome changed on the replaced run shown without both.
entries: Each entry says what it is, naming the host it is read on, the Zen 1 or the M4, or both with across_hosts and its reason. Its file is its kind, a pattern per host under kinds with * for the commit, and its host. A value is an expression on that file, as expressions says; a bar is a target row's value, after its comparator, at the row's scale and in its unit, with the fewest digits that show it exactly; a target is a row's measured figure for a part, read through the row, at the row's scale, digits and unit; a verdict is the Targets block's own, render_results.py's verdict_class or, with words text, verdict_of, on the row and the parts named; path gives the matched file's path; words gives the text for true or false; carries names the ranking words a figure computed by a ranking form stands for; gap ratio or difference refuses a gap printed as none. measured_commit, commit_exceptions, pin_of, note_of and changed are shown from the page's whole reading. A format is a number's, {:,} or {:d} for a whole number and {:,.2f} and the like for any other, after scale, a declared factor; or text, list (with empty for none), or system. A kind marked pending has no file yet: its tokens wait, and the reason says what it needs. A kind's commit is where its files name their commit (header.commit unless given); exception, with why and says, lets its files name another commit or, with no_commit, none; another commit holds only where git finds nothing that the files read at the measured commit measure, by scripts/check_ties.py's kinds, changed between the two; pin names the data_pins.json pin its files are under and what the essay says of them; note is what the essay says of its files wherever it shows them. claims are sentences of the template that rank, compare or judge, each with its text and a condition, holds, on the figures the sentence prints or a verdict, or pitch_claim, a claim of the README's pitch in targets.json. census names a section and the verdict classes whose rows it must hold. replaced names the comparison kind a replaced run's kind stands beside.
expressions: A value is one of scripts/targets.json's expressions, which render_results.py evaluates on the entry's file: {"path": [...]}, where "@headline" is the headline_variant of the object above, and {"name": n} in a path picks the one item of a list so named; {"case", "field"}; {"cases_median", "field"}; {"best", "family", "not_family"}; {"codec", "column", "field"}; {"store_bits", "per"}; {"min_variant"}; {"lowest_system" | "lowest_value"}; {"engine_only"}. Or one of the list's own: {"div" | "mul" | "sub" | "add": [a, b]}; {"min" | "max" | "median": values, "only_above" | "only_below": e}; {"each": items, "of": e}, e with each item in place of $; {"all": values}, all true; {"above" | "below": [a, b]}; {"same": [a, b]}, a value two readings must agree on; {"log2": e} of a power of two; {"concat": [...]} of text; {"prefix": e, "length": n}; {"codec_column", "field"}; {"least": {"column", "family" | "not_family", "field"}}, the least field of an exact codec; {"codec_columns": {"with_family", "except"}}, the codec-eval columns with such a codec; {"items": path, "field"} and {"where": path, "match", "field"}, a field of each item of a list; {"count": path, "where"}; {"count_cases": pattern, "field", "at_least"}; {"flagged_queries": path to a variant}, its timed query blocks with a page swapped in; {"target_values": {"id", "host"}}, the values of a target row's parts read from the entry's kind; {"bar": {"id", "host"}}, a target row's value; {"verdict_is": {"id", "host", "parts", "class"}}, whether a row's verdict class is that; {"prover": {"source", "count"}}, the prover's listed faults, its control left out, or what its record covers, proves, or whether its controls passed; {"pow2": e}; {"not": e}; {"any": values}; {"is": [e, w]}, w a verdict word; {"figure": name}, another entry's value before its format; {"constant": {"source", "pattern"}}, group 1 of the one line of a source file the pattern matches; {"count_matches": pattern, "source", "between"}; {"lines": [globs]}, the files' lines. A literal number is one of factors, each with its reason; a whole number in a path is a list's item at that place. A constant's until says what it waits for while its pattern matches nothing.
